summary: Full backend + frontend testing of ChemiVerse MVP. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass (root, progress accumulation, quiz partial + perfect, leaderboard sorting, tutor SSE stream + history persistence via Claude Sonnet 4.6). Frontend: all 10 pages load without JS/console errors and every interactive flow (nav, periodic search+filter+navigate, element prev/next, atom pick+slider, molecule switch, reaction run+reset, virtual lab mix, quiz complete+XP, AI tutor SSE streaming, dashboard progress fetch) verified working end-to-end.

issues: Assistant messages contain markdown syntax (**bold**, > blockquote) but are rendered as raw text via whitespace-pre-wrap. Consider using a markdown renderer (e.g. react-markdown) so bold, lists and blockquotes render properly since the system prompt explicitly instructs the model to use markdown.
Element cells rely on category color badges only; there is no visible tooltip/description on hover — acceptable but could improve discoverability.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Render markdown in AI Tutor assistant bubbles (react-markdown) — currently raw ** and > characters are visible.
OPTIONAL: In PeriodicGalaxy.jsx, the selector [data-testid^="element-"] also matches the search input data-testid="element-search" (this only affected test counting, not functionality). Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py tutor_stream loads prior history from Mongo into local variable but never sends it back to LlmChat — the prior variable is unused (LlmChat maintains its own session by session_id, so functionally correct, but the query is dead code; either remove or wire it up).

server.py update_progress mutates the doc dict from find_one which contains _id has been excluded via projection {'_id':0} — good. However $set of the whole doc including user_id is redundant on upsert. Acceptable.
AITutor.jsx renders markdown as pre-wrapped plain text. Backend prompt explicitly instructs use of markdown, so a renderer should be added.

Quiz.jsx uses setTimeout inside choose() and reads `score` closure value — a stale-closure bug is possible but is compensated with `score + (correct?1:0)`. OK but could be cleaner with functional setState.
No auth on any endpoint (by design — anonymous localStorage user id). Not a bug for this MVP.
No rate limiting on /api/tutor/chat — potential cost concern in production.
Files are reasonably small (<200 lines each); no >700 line files.
test_credentials: N/A — anonymous localStorage user id (cv_uid) is auto-generated. Test users created: TEST_user_*, TEST_quiz_*, TEST_perfect_*, TEST_lb1_*, TEST_lb2_*
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seeded TEST_-prefixed users in db.progress and TEST_sess_* session in db.tutor_messages for verification. Not cleaned up (small volume, prefixed for safety).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers: root, progress get/update accumulation, quiz partial + perfect achievement, leaderboard sort, SSE /api/tutor/chat streaming + /api/tutor/history persistence. All pass with real Emergent LLM key (Claude Sonnet 4.6). Frontend has data-testid coverage across all 10 pages; Quiz auto-advance uses ~900ms setTimeout so allow >=1500ms between clicks in playwright. AI Tutor streams SSE via fetch ReadableStream — assistant markdown is not rendered (raw text). Dashboard reads /api/progress/{uid} using localStorage id 'cv_uid'.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Only design polish (markdown rendering in AITutor) is worth doing before final delivery.
